GenericAdvancedSearch.title: Enhanced search API
GenericAdvancedSearch.summary: This topic describes how to invoke the enhanced search operation (GenericAdvancedSearch) by using the Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI SDK, including the method and metric description. Compared with GenericSearch, GenericAdvancedSearch provides better recall of authoritative websites, with a maximum recall count of 40, delivering improved authoritativeness and data diversity. The response parameters and format of the enhanced operation are consistent with those of GenericAdvancedSearch.

OmniAnswer.title: AI chat
OmniAnswer.summary: This topic describes the SearchStream API operation for AI chat with streaming output. Based on retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and large language model technologies, this operation accepts natural language questions from users and automatically performs intention recognition, query rewrite, multi-source retrieve, and content generation. The operation returns data by using the Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming protocol, and supports real-time output of inference status, reference sources, and token-by-token generated answers. This operation is suitable for AI chat and search scenarios that require low latency and high explainability.

ReadPageBasic.title: Parse static page
ReadPageBasic.summary: Quickly fetches HTML and parses static web page content.

ReadPageScrape.title: Parse web page content
ReadPageScrape.summary:
1. Reads HTML and parses web page content through a browser sandbox environment.
2. The operation begins parsing after the target page resources are fully loaded (you can adjust the maximum wait time through the pageTimeout parameter). The overall response time is significantly affected by the resource loading status of the target site.

ScanFile.title: Scan a file
ScanFile.summary: Scans document images (such as exam papers, books, official documents, certificates, and line drawings) and converts them into scanned copies by using the latest AI technology. This operation provides powerful image processing capabilities that effectively remove noise and correct image distortion, achieving high-definition scanning effects that can replace traditional scanners with photos.

UnifiedSearch.title: Tongxiao unified search API
UnifiedSearch.summary: Provides access to the Tongxiao unified search API, enabling quick and easy integration of web-wide general search capabilities.
